title: Scheduled workflow runs late and an hour guard skips every run while reporting success
symptoms: Runs show success but the job did nothing
No output for days with a green run history
cause: Scheduled workflows are queued and can start well after the cron time. A guard that checks the local hour skipped both daily firings, and the workflow still finished green.
fix: Deduplicate on the date rather than the hour, and record when real work happened.
apply: In the job, skip only if a marker for today's date already exists; otherwise do the work and write the marker.
affected: GitHub Actions schedule trigger, August and September 2026
